 Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026: Match 26, UBL vs UT Match Prediction – Who will win today’s match between UAE Bulls vs United Tigers?
 UAE Bulls (UBL) take on United Tigers (UT) in match No. 26 at the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026 at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday, November 18.
 By Adreej Kumar Mitra Published - 17 Nov 2026, 19:06 IST 
 4 Min Read
 UAE Bulls and United Tigers. (Photo Source: Abu Dhabi T10) UAE Bulls (UBL) take on United Tigers (UT) in match No. 26 at the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026 at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday, November 18.
 Kieron Pollard-led UAE Bulls are placed at No. 5 on the points table. They have won two games and lost five in seven. In their most recent fixture, the Emirates Eagles defeated them by nine runs. With three games remaining, The UAE Bulls will be desperate to close the gap with the Eagles, who are at No. 4. They will face the Royal Desert Champions on Tuesday.
 Fakhar Zaman's United Tigers are positioned at No. 2 on the points table. They have won five matches and lost three after playing eight. However, they are on a two-match losing streak. The Arabian Aces defeated them on Monday.

 UBL vs UT: Probable Best Performer of the Match
 Probable Best Batter: Fakhar Zaman
 Fakhar Zaman would want to lead from the front on Wednesday. In eight innings, the southpaw has scored 225 runs at an average of 37.50 and a strike rate of 199.11. Zaman will look to get his team off to a flying start at the top of the order.
 Probable Best Bowler: Mohammad Amir 
 Mohammad Amir could be the bowler to watch out for on Wednesday. The left-arm pacer has taken nine wickets from seven matches at an average of 18 and an economy rate of 12.46. He will look to make early inroads with the new ball. 
 Today's Match Prediction : United Tigers to win the match
